fact: INEC chairman Joash Amupitan said the Voter Register Department completed the final Automated Biometric Identification System (ABIS) cleanup and the national register of voters is now more than 103 million.
Amupitan said the public display of the Preliminary Register for claims and objections had been completed before the final ABIS cleanup.

Acting INEC chairman Rhoda Gumus said INEC, through collaboration with NIMC and its continuous voter registration portal, has systematically integrated National Identification Numbers to audit, verify and clean the national voter register.
INEC's Bimodal Voter Accreditation System uses fingerprint or facial verification to match voters against the electoral register, and was first used nationwide in the 2023 general elections.
INEC's ICT director Lawrence Bayode said the Automated Biometric Identification System was run on the registration records of the preliminary voters' register, finding irregular entries.
